description: Capstone (6 of 6) of the agent-agnostic epic: finalize and gate the assembled cross-agent system across TWO repos. items.title: Add SKILL.md frontmatter JSON Schema + make check-spec-purity.py schema-driven (+ anti-drift pytest)
items.description:
All files live in the ../feature-forge repo. Establish the single declarative source of truth for spec-pure SKILL.md frontmatter and make the existing checker load its key sets from it (REQ-CI-02, REQ-CONST-03, REQ-VER-03).

1. Create `references/skill-frontmatter.schema.json` EXACTLY as given in spec 00 §3 (JSON Schema draft 2020-12): `required: [name, description]`, `additionalProperties: false`, `properties` = the 6 keys name/description/license/compatibility/metadata/allowed-tools.
2. Edit `scripts/check-spec-purity.py`: add `import json` to the stdlib imports; add `SCHEMA_REL_PATH = 'references/skill-frontmatter.schema.json'` and a `_load_frontmatter_key_sets(root)` helper (full body in 02 §4.2) that returns (REQUIRED, ALLOWED) frozensets from the schema's `required`/`properties`, raising SystemExit if the schema is missing/unparseable. In `main()`, after resolving `root`, set the module globals `REQUIRED_FRONTMATTER_KEYS`/`ALLOWED_FRONTMATTER_KEYS` from that loader. Drop the hard-coded `OPTIONAL_FRONTMATTER_KEYS` block. Leave the name==dir / residual-var / prelude / body-size checks untouched.
3. Edit `tests/test_check_spec_purity.py`: add `test_loaded_keysets_match_schema` (full body in 02 §4.2) asserting the loaded ALLOWED/REQUIRED equal the schema's properties/required and the exact 6/2-key sets.

Do NOT change any SKILL.md files. Do NOT alter the other purity checks.
acceptanceCriteria: references/skill-frontmatter.schema.json exists and parses as valid JSON; properties has exactly the 6 keys, required is [name, description], additionalProperties is false
check-spec-purity.py loads ALLOWED/REQUIRED from the schema via _load_frontmatter_key_sets() and no longer hard-codes the key sets
Run from ../feature-forge: `python3 -m pytest tests -q` passes, including test_loaded_keysets_match_schema
Run from ../feature-forge: `bash scripts/validate.sh` step 6a (check-spec-purity) still passes for all 11 skills
Negative check: temporarily adding a `version:` key to any skills/*/SKILL.md makes check-spec-purity.py fail with a disallowed-key violation (revert after)
items.notes: Foundation for the whole CI gate. The schema is consumed by item 004 (validate.sh claude-validate fallback) and item 005 (composite runs validate.sh step 6a). additionalProperties:false is what mechanically enforces spec-purity (no vendor/version keys). The quoted REQ-FM-01/REQ-VND-01 IDs inside check-spec-purity.py are forge-skill-spec-purity's IDs carried in source — leave them as-is.

items.title: Add feature-forge os-matrix.yml installer gate (ubuntu/macos/windows)

items.title: Add .gitattributes (LF + export-ignore) to both repos
items.description:
One file in THIS repo (rauf) and one in the ../feature-forge repo (neither has a .gitattributes today). Add cross-OS hygiene (REQ-OS-01, REQ-OS-02) per spec 06 §5.

1. feature-forge/.gitattributes EXACTLY as in 06 §5.1: `* text=auto eol=lf`, `*.png binary`, `*.jpg binary`, and export-ignore for `specs/ tests/ .github/ eval/ plans/`.
2. rauf/.gitattributes EXACTLY as in 06 §5.2: `* text=auto eol=lf`, `*.png binary`, `*.jpg binary`, and export-ignore for `specs/ tests/ .github/ test-sandbox/`.

Neither file may contain a `* -text` blanket (it would disable normalization and risk the executable-bit handling). The mode bit is tracked separately in the tree object, so `eol=lf` does not strip +x — do not add any chmod automation.
acceptanceCriteria: feature-forge/.gitattributes exists with `* text=auto eol=lf`, the two binary lines, and export-ignore for specs/ tests/ .github/ eval/ plans/

Neither .gitattributes contains a `* -text` blanket

items.notes: export-ignore only affects `git archive` output, not the working tree or clone. The per-repo export-ignore tree lists differ (eval/ + plans/ for feature-forge; test-sandbox/ for rauf). items.title: rauf npm-publishability prep + optional npm-publish.yml (no publish; flag OQ-A)
items.description:
Files live in THIS repo (rauf). Make rauf publishable WITHOUT executing any publish (tech-spec §3.13 / decision 1) per spec 06 §7.

1. On the ONE package that will become the published unscoped `rauf` (the target the installer's `RAUF_PIN = rauf@0.6.0` resolves — see OQ-A below), add npm-publish metadata: remove `private: true`, add `publishConfig: { access: public }`, `files: ['dist']`, and `bin: { rauf: 'dist/index.js' }` (already present on @rauf/cli). Do NOT change ANY `version` field — every workspace manifest must stay 0.6.0 so `pnpm version:check` stays green. Do NOT run `npm publish`.
2. Optionally add `.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml` as `workflow_dispatch`-only machinery per the 06 §7.2 skeleton, with the actual `npm publish` step left COMMENTED. Outside the PR gate; not run by this feature.
3. OQ-A (rauf distribution form: Bun-required npm package vs compiled-binary-via-thin-wrapper) is UNRESOLVED — surface this choice to the maintainer in the item output / notes rather than silently picking one.
acceptanceCriteria: The package targeted by the rauf@0.6.0 pin has publishConfig/files/bin set and is no longer private, with NO version field changed anywhere
`pnpm version:check` (and full `pnpm gate`) still passes — all six manifests remain 0.6.0
No `npm publish` is executed; if npm-publish.yml is added it triggers on workflow_dispatch only and its publish step is commented out

items.notes: rauf-side item — verified with `pnpm gate`. @rauf/cli is name '@rauf/cli', private:true, bin rauf -> dist/index.js; root manifest is name 'rauf', private:true, no bin. Which becomes the published `rauf` is the deferred OQ-A; the prep must be compatible with either resolution. The CLI uses a Bun shebang, so a plain npx needs Bun present — exactly why OQ-A is open.
